title: Ospreay tries to solve KUSHIDA
summary: Will Ospreay’s spectacular style meets KUSHIDA’s technical control. Repeated frustration makes overcoming the junior champion an important step in Ospreay’s New Japan career.

chapters.title: The newcomer loses his first title challenge
chapters.result: KUSHIDA defeats Ospreay to retain the junior championship.
chapters.context: Ospreay’s arrival immediately reaches the title picture, but the established champion remains a problem he cannot yet solve.

chapters.title: Ospreay finally takes the championship
chapters.result: Ospreay defeats KUSHIDA for the IWGP junior title.
chapters.context: The breakthrough turns a recurring competitive obstacle into Ospreay’s first reign at the top of the division.
